references.text: Moses was commanded to build an altar of uncut stones, without using iron tools
Moses commanded the Israelites to build an altar of whole stones that had not been shaped with iron, and to offer burnt offerings and peace offerings on it
The command to offer peace offerings and eat them there with joy before the Lord
Moses built an altar and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings to the Lord
Joshua was told to hold fast to the Book of the Law of Moses and do everything written in it
Joshua built an altar for the Lord, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal
Elijah built an altar of twelve uncut stones in the name of the Lord
Moses is described as the servant of the Lord, faithful in all God's house
